failure_reason: GitHub returned 429 abuse-detection rate limits for the issues the agent needed, so it could read only one page and could not complete the fixture, tests, upload or documentation.
description: The agent attempted seven GitHub issue requests and was rate-limited on all of them, then only reached the Hugging Face datasets listing. Its final output states too few pages were readable to write from, so none of the required GLB fixture work was done.
